title: One-sided Lebesgue differentiation on ℝ: ε⁻¹∫_{(t−ε,t)} φ → φ(t) for a.e. t (parent Step 6)
statement: For every locally integrable φ : ℝ → ℝ (Lebesgue measure) and for Lebesgue-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, ε⁻¹·∫_{(t−ε,t)} φ(r) dr → φ(t) as ε → 0⁺ (along the filter of right neighbourhoods 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, LocallyIntegrable φ (volume : Measure ℝ) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => ε⁻¹ * ∫ r in Ioo (t - ε) t, φ r) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (φ t))
